newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: At least 23 bus passengers die in S.African smash.
newsitem.headline: At least 23 bus passengers die in S.African smash.

text.p: At least 23 people were killed and another 26 injured in a fiery road accident in South Africa on Saturday when a passenger bus collided with a petrol tanker, police said.
"The vehicles were totally burnt out and the bodies were badly charred. We are not sure yet but the death toll is now between 23 and 30 people," a police spokeswoman told Reuters.
"There are 14 people critically injured and another 12 who are seriously hurt."

The accident occurred near the town of Warmbaths north of Pretoria at about 1.30 p.m. (1130 GMT), apparently when the passenger bus pulled out to overtake a minibus taxi, and collided with a petrol tanker. Both vehicles burst into flames.
The drivers of the passenger bus and the tanker died instantly.

The fire was brought under control by late Saturday afternoon, but the road was closed to traffic to allow police and rescue workers to help the survivors. Helicopters and ambulances were called in to ferry the injured to hospital.
